sections.label: Book 33
sections.name: The Sarvamedha continued; praise of Agni, Indra, Surya

verses.sa: अस्याजरासो दमामरित्रा अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः। श्वितीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवो वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः॥
verses.tr: asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ
verses.en: His be the fires, eternal, purifying, protectors of our homes, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and seated in the wood: like winds are Somas.

verses.sa: हरयो धूमकेतवो वातजूता उप द्यवि। यतन्ते वृथगग्नयः॥
verses.tr: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi yatante vṛthagagnayaḥ
verses.en: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.

verses.sa: यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाँ२ ऋतं बृहत्। अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम्॥
verses.tr: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devāṃ2 ṛtaṃ bṛhat agne yakṣi svaṃ damam
verses.en: Bring to us Mitra-Varuna, bring the Gods to the great sacrifice; Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ२ अश्वाँ२ अग्ने रथीरिव। नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi devahūtamāṃ2 aśvāṃ2 agne rathīriva ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ
verses.en: 'Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

verses.sa: द्वे विरूपे चरतः स्वर्थे अन्याऽन्या वत्समुप धापयेते। हरिरन्यस्यां भवति स्वधावाञ्छुक्रो अन्यस्यां ददृशे सुवर्चाः॥
verses.tr: dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe anyā'nyā vatsamupa dhāpayete hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvāñchukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ
verses.en: To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant. One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour: bright and fairshining is be with the other.

verses.sa: अयमिह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर्होता यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यः। यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुर्वनेषु चित्रं विभ्वं विशे-विशे॥
verses.tr: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśe-viśe
verses.en: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites, Whom Apnavana and the Bbrigus caused to shine, bright -coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.

verses.sa: त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन्। औक्षन् घृतैरस्तृणन् बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयन्त॥
verses.tr: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan aukṣan ghṛtairastṛṇan barhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta
verses.en: Three times a hundred Gods, and thrice 'a thousand, and three times ten, and nine have worshipped Agni, For him spread sacred grass, balmed'*' him with butter, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

verses.sa: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम्। कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्ना पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.en: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvinara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sa: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया। समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः॥
verses.tr: agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ
verses.en: May Agni slay the foemen,—fain for riches, through the love of song Kindled, bright, served with sacrifice.

verses.sa: विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इन्द्रेण वायुना। पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः॥
verses.tr: viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvagna indreṇa vāyunā pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ
verses.en: With the All- Gods, with Indra and with Vaya drink the Soma mead, O Agni, after Mitra's laws.

verses.sa: आ यदिषे नृपतिं तेज आनट् शुचि रेतो निषिक्तं द्यौरभीके। अग्निः शर्धमनवद्यं युवानं स्वाध्यं जनयत् सूदयच्च॥
verses.tr: ā yadiṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭ śuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaurabhīke agniḥ śardhamanavadyaṃ yuvānaṃ svādhyaṃ janayat sūdayacca
verses.en: When splendour reached the Lord of men to speed him, down from the heaven was shed the brilliant moisture. Agni brought forth to light and filled with spirit the youthful host benevolent and blameless.

verses.sa: अग्ने शर्ध महते सौभगाय तव द्युम्नान्युत्तमानि सन्तु। सं जास्पत्यं सुयममा कृणुष्व शत्रूयतामभि तिष्ठा महांसि॥
verses.tr: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi
verses.en: Show thyself strong, for mighty bliss, O Agni; most excellent be thine effulgent splendours. Make easy to maintain our household lordship and trample down the might of those who hate us.

verses.sa: त्वां हि मन्द्रतममर्कशोकैर्ववृमहे महि नः श्रोष्यग्ने। इन्द्रं न त्वा शवसा देवता वायुं पृणन्ति राधसा नृतमाः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ hi mandratamamarkaśokairvavṛmahe mahi naḥ śroṣyagne indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ
verses.en: We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams' glow: hear our great laud, O Agni. The best men' praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like V^yu in thy bounty.

verses.sa: त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः। यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वान् दयन्त गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvān dayanta gonām
verses.en: Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part in Iti gifts their stalls of kine.

verses.sa: श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः। आ सीदन्तु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावाणो अध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram
verses.en: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods. Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.

verses.sa: विश्वेषामदितिर्यज्ञियानां विश्वेषामतिथिर्मानुषाणाम्। अग्निर्देवानामव आवृणानः सुमृडीको भवतु जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāmaditiryajñiyānāṃ viśveṣāmatithirmānuṣāṇām agnirdevānāmava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ
verses.en: The Freedom of all Gods who merit worship, freely received as Guest in all men's houses, Agni who hath secured the Gods' high favour, may he be gracious to us, Jatavedas.

verses.sa: महो अग्नेः समिधानस्य शर्मण्यनागा मित्रे वरुणे स्वस्तये। श्रेष्ठे स्याम सवितुः सवीमनि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: In great enkindled Agni's keeping and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna, May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa: आपश्चित्पिप्यु स्तर्यो न गावो नक्षन्नृतं जरितारस्त इन्द्र। याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छा त्वं हि धीभिर्दयसे वि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: āpaścitpipyu staryo na gāvo nakṣannṛtaṃ jaritārasta indra yāhi vāyurna niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhirdayase vi vājān
verses.en: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: singers approached thy holy cult, O Indra. Come thou to us as to his team comes VAyu. Thou through our solemn hymns bestowest bounty.

verses.sa: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा। उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया॥
verses.tr: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
verses.en: Ye Cows, protect the fount. The two mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sa: यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा। सुवाति सविता भगः॥
verses.tr: yadadya sūra udite'nāgā mitro aryamā suvāti savitā bhagaḥ
verses.en: Now when the Sun hath risen to-day, may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar speed us forth.

verses.sa: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियम्। रसा दधीत वृषभम्॥ तं प्रत्नथा ऽयं वेनः॥
verses.tr: ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyorabhiśriyam rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ
verses.en: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth: Supply the liquid to the Bull. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena.

verses.sa: आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषञ्छ्रियो वसानश्चरति स्वरोचिः। महत्तद्वृष्णो असुरस्य नामा विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ॥
verses.tr: ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣañchriyo vasānaścarati svarociḥ mahattadvṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau
verses.en: As he was rising up they all revered him: self-luminous he travels, clothed in splendour. That is the Bull's, the Asura's lofty nature: he, Omniform, hath reached the eternal waters.

verses.sa: प्र वो महे मन्दमानायान्धसोऽर्चा विश्वानराय विश्वाभुवे। इन्द्रस्य यस्य सुमखं सहो महि श्रवो नृम्णं च रोदसी सपर्यतः॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ
verses.en: I laud your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is good to all men, who pervadeth all; Indra whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.

verses.sa: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्तं पृथुः स्वरुः। येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा॥
verses.tr: bṛhannididhma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaruḥ yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā
verses.en: Great is their fuel, strong their laud, wide is their sacrificial^!, >fit Whose Friend is Indra, ever young.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः। महाँ२ अभिष्टिरोजसा॥
verses.tr: indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ mahāṃ2 abhiṣṭirojasā
verses.en: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Conqueror, mighty in thy strength.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो वृत्रमवृणोच्छर्धनीतिः प्र मायिनाममिनाद्वर्पणीतिः। अहन् व्यंसमुशधग्वनेष्वाविर्धेना अकृणोद्राम्याणाम्॥
verses.tr: indro vṛtramavṛṇocchardhanītiḥ pra māyināmaminādvarpaṇītiḥ ahan vyaṃsamuśadhagvaneṣvāvirdhenā akṛṇodrāmyāṇām
verses.en: Leading his band, Indra encompassed Vritra; weak gret the wily leader of enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and made the milch-kine of the nights apparent.

verses.sa: कुतस्त्वमिन्द्र माहिनः सन्नेको यासि सत्पते किं त इत्था। सं पृच्छसे समराणः शुभानैर्वोचेस्तन्नो हरिवो यत्ते अस्मे। महाँ२ इन्द्रो य ओजसा कदा चन स्तरीरसि कदा चन प्र युच्छसि॥
verses.tr: kutastvamindra māhinaḥ sanneko yāsi satpate kiṃ ta itthā saṃ pṛcchase samarāṇaḥ śubhānairvocestanno harivo yatte asme mahāṃ2 indro ya ojasā kadā cana starīrasi kadā cana pra yucchasi
verses.en: Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose? Thou greetest us, encountering us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us, Indra, great in his power and might. Ne'er art thou fruit' less. Never art thou neglectful.

verses.sa: आ तत्त इन्द्रायवः पनन्ताभि य ऊर्वं गोमन्तं तितृत्सान्। सकृत्स्वं ये पुरुपुत्रां महीं सहस्रधारां बृहतीं दुदुक्षन्॥
verses.tr: ā tatta indrāyavaḥ panantābhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān sakṛtsvaṃ ye puruputrāṃ mahīṃ sahasradhārāṃ bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan
verses.en: Those men extolled that deed of thine, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle, Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose sons are many and her streams a thousand.

verses.sa: इमां ते धियं प्र भरे महो महीमस्य स्तोत्रे धिषणा यत्त आनजे। तमुत्सवे च प्रसवे च सासहिमिन्द्रं देवासः शवसामदन्ननु॥
verses.tr: imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimindraṃ devāsaḥ śavasāmadannanu
verses.en: To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud. In Indra, yea, in him victorious through his might, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.

verses.sa: विभ्राड् बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम्। वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पुपोष पुरुधा वि राजति॥
verses.tr: vibhrāḍ bṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati
verses.en: May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled mead, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life; He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shone o'er many a land.

verses.sa: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः। दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
verses.en: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Surya, that all may look on him.

verses.sa: येना पावक चक्षसा भुरण्यन्तं जनाँ२ अनु। त्वं वरुण पश्यसि॥
verses.tr: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ2 anu tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
verses.en: Pure Varuna, with that same eye wherewith thou lookest upon one Actively stirring mid the folk—

verses.sa: दैव्यावध्वर्यू आ गतं रथेन सूर्यत्वचा। मध्वा यज्ञं समञ्जाथे। तं प्रत्नथा ऽयं वेनश्चित्रं देवानाम्॥
verses.tr: daivyāvadhvaryū ā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā madhvā yajñaṃ samañjāthe taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaścitraṃ devānām
verses.en: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, come hither upon a sun-bright car: Bedew our sacrifice with mead. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. The brilliant presence.

verses.sa: आ न इडाभिर्विदथे सुशस्ति विश्वानरः सविता देव एतु। अपि यथा युवानो मत्सथा नो विश्वं जगदभिपित्वे मनीषा॥
verses.tr: ā na iḍābhirvidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā
verses.en: Loved of all men, may Savitar through praises offered as sacred food come to our synod, That ye too, through our hymns, ye ever youthful, may gladden at your visit all our people.

verses.sa: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य। सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे॥
verses.tr: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe
verses.en: Whatever, Vvitra-slayer! thou SArya hast risen on to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

verses.sa: तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य। विश्वमा भासि रोचनम्॥
verses.tr: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya viśvamā bhāsi rocanam
verses.en: Swift, visible to all art thou, O SArya, maker of the light, Illuming, all the radiant realm.

verses.sa: तत्सूर्यस्य देवत्वं तन्महित्वं मध्या कर्तोर्विततं सं जभार। यदेदयुक्त हरितः सधस्थादाद्रात्री वासस्तनुते सिमस्मै॥
verses.tr: tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃ jabhāra yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthādādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai
verses.en: This is the Godhead, this the might of Surya: he hath withdrawn what spread o'er work uufiuished. When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.

verses.sa: तन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याभिचक्षे सूर्यो रूपं कृणुते द्योरुपस्थे। अनन्तमन्यद्रुशदस्य पाजः कृष्णमन्यद्धरितः सं भरन्ति॥
verses.tr: tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe anantamanyadruśadasya pājaḥ kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃ bharanti
verses.en: In the sky's lap the Sun this form assumeth that Varuna and Mitra may behold it. His Bay Steeds well maintain their power eternal, at one time bright, and darksome at another.

verses.sa: बण्महाँ२ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाँ२ असि। महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ२ असि॥
verses.tr: baṇmahāṃ2 asi sūrya baḍāditya mahāṃ2 asi mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahāṃ2 asi
verses.en: Verily, SArya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily thou, God, art great.

verses.sa: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ२ असि सत्रा देव महाँ२ असि। मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम्॥
verses.tr: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahāṃ2 asi satrā deva mahāṃ2 asi mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam
verses.en: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame: thou, evermore, O God, art great, Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' Home^priest, divine, far-spread, unconquerable light.

verses.sa: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत। वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम॥
verses.tr: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima
verses.en: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sa: अद्या देवा उदिता सूर्यस्य निरंहसः पिपृता निरवद्यात्। तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: adyā devā uditā sūryasya niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: To-day, ye Gods, when S SArya hath ascended, deliver us from trouble and dishonour. This boon may Varuria and Mitra grant us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa: आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च। हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन्॥
verses.tr: ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan
verses.en: Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, Borne on his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God, beholding living creatures.

verses.sa: प्र वावृजे सुप्रया बर्हिरेषामा विश्पतीव व्वीरिट इयाते। विशामक्तोरुषसः पूर्वहूतौ वायुः पूषा स्वस्तये नियुत्वान्॥
verses.tr: pra vāvṛje suprayā barhireṣāmā viśpatīva vvīriṭa iyāte viśāmaktoruṣasaḥ pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān
verses.en: Soft to the "tread the sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them, At the folk's early call on Night and Morning,—Viyu, and Pdshan with his team to bless us.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगम्। आदित्यान् मारुतं गणम्॥
verses.tr: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam ādityān mārutaṃ gaṇam
verses.en: Indra, VSyu, Brihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pushan, Bhaga, Adityas) and the t^e Marut host.

verses.sa: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः। करतां नः सुराधसः॥
verses.tr: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvanmitro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ
verses.en: Be Varuna our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids: Both make us rich exceedingly! I

verses.sa: अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम्। इता मरुतो अश्विना। तं प्रत्नथा ऽयं वेनो ये देवास आ न इडाभिर्विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वोमासश्चर्षणीधृतः॥
verses.tr: adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām itā maruto aśvinā taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ veno ye devāsa ā na iḍābhirviśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvomāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ
verses.en: Regard us, Indra, Vishnu, here, ye Asvins, and the Marut host, us who are kith and kin to you. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. O ye eleven Gods. Loved of all men, may Savitar. With the All-Gods. Ye Visvedevas who protect.

verses.sa: अग्न इन्द्र वरुण मित्र देवाः शर्धः प्र यन्त मारुतोत विष्णो। उभा नासत्या रुद्रो अध ग्नाः पूषा भगः सरस्वती जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: agna indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta
verses.en: O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Vishnu. May both Nasatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pushan, Sarasvatt, Bhaga accept us.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणादितिं स्वः पृथिवीं द्यां मरुतः पर्वताँ२ अपः। हुवे विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं भगं नु शंसं सवितारमूतये॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditiṃ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ marutaḥ parvatāṃ2 apaḥ huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāramūtaye
verses.en: Indra, Agni, Mitra, Varuria, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven, Vishnu I call, PAshan and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Sarasa, Savitar that they may help.

verses.sa: अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वृत्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः। यः शंसते स्तुवते धायि पज्र इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अस्माँ२ अवन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmāṃ2 avantu devāḥ
verses.en: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle at the death of Vritra, The strong, assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra as their chief protect us.

verses.sa: अर्वाञ्चो अद्या भवता यजत्रा आ वो हार्दि भयमानो व्ययेयम्। त्राध्वं नो देवा निजुरो वृकस्य त्राध्वं कर्तादवपदो यजत्राः॥
verses.tr: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ
verses.en: Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing in my heart I may approach you. Protect us, Gods, let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye Holy, from the pit and falling.

verses.sa: विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः। विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे॥
verses.tr: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme
verses.en: This day come all the Maruts, etc., as in XIII.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवाः शृणुतेमं हवं मे ये अन्तरिक्षे य उप द्यवि ष्ठ। ये अग्निजिह्वा उत वा यजत्रा आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam
verses.en: Listen, All Gods, to this mine invocation, ye who inhabit heaven and air's mid-region. All ye, O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass be joyful.

verses.sa: देवेभ्यो हि प्रथमं यज्ञियेभ्योऽमृतत्वं सुवसि भागमुत्तमम्। आदिद्दामानं सवितर्व्यूर्णुषेऽनूचीना जीविता मानुषेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatvaṃ suvasi bhāgamuttamam ādiddāmānaṃ savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ
verses.en: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality. Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.

verses.sa: प्र वायुमच्छा बृहती मनीषा बृहद्रयिं विश्ववारं रथप्राम्। द्युतद्यामा नियुतः पत्यमानः कविः कविमियक्षसि प्रयज्यो॥
verses.tr: pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāraṃ rathaprām dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo
verses.en: I with a lofty song call hither Viyu all-bounteous, filler of I his car,, most wealthy. Thou, Sage,, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतम्। इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि॥
verses.tr: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam indavo vāmuśanti hi
verses.en: These, Indra-Vayu, have been shed,, etc., as in VII..

verses.sa: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम्। धियं घृताचीं साधन्ता॥
verses.tr: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhantā
verses.en: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

verses.sa: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः। आ यातं रुद्रवर्तनी॥ तं प्रत्नथा ऽयं वेनः॥
verses.tr: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ā yātaṃ rudravartanī taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ
verses.en: Nasatyas, Wonder-workers, yours are these libations with chpt grass. Come ye whose paths are bright with glow.

verses.sa: विदद्यदी सरमा रुग्णमद्रेर्महि पाथः पूर्व्यं सध्र्यक्कः। अग्रं नयत्सुपद्यक्षराणामच्छा रवं प्रथमा जानती गात्॥
verses.tr: vidadyadī saramā rugṇamadrermahi pāthaḥ pūrvyaṃ sadhryakkaḥ agraṃ nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt
verses.en: When Sarama had found the mountain's fissure, that vast and ancient place she plundered thoroughly. In the floods' van she led them forth, light-footed: she who well knew came first unto their lowing.

verses.sa: नहि स्पशमविदन्नन्यमस्माद्वैश्वानरात्पुर एतारमग्नेः। एमेनमवृधन्नमृता अमर्त्यं वैश्वानरं क्षैत्रजित्याय देवाः॥
verses.tr: nahi spaśamavidannanyamasmādvaiśvānarātpura etāramagneḥ emenamavṛdhannamṛtā amartyaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ kṣaitrajityāya devāḥ
verses.en: For nowhere did they find another envoy to lead the way than this Vaifv^nara Agni. The Gods immortal strengthened the immortal Vaisvanara to win the land in battle.

verses.sa: उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे। ता नो मृडात ईदृशे॥
verses.tr: ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe tā no mṛḍāta īdṛśe
verses.en: The strong, dispellers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke: May they be kind to one like me,

verses.sa: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे। अभि देवाँ२ इयक्षते॥
verses.tr: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave abhi devāṃ2 iyakṣate
verses.en: Sing forth to Indu, ye men, to him as he is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

verses.sa: ये त्वाऽहिहत्ये मघवन्नवर्धन्ये शाम्बरे हरिवो ये गविष्टौ। ये त्वा नूनमनुमदन्ति विप्राः पिबेन्द्र सोमं सगणो मरुद्भिः॥
verses.tr: ye tvā'hihatye maghavannavardhanye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somaṃ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ
verses.en: Drink Soma, Indra, banded with the Maruts who, Boon Lord! strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter, 'Gainst §Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now rejoice in thee, the holy singers.

verses.sa: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः। अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा॥
verses.tr: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā
verses.en: Thou wast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage. There, even there the Maruts strengthened Indra when his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.

verses.sa: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि। महान्महीभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi mahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: O thou 'who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side. Mighty One with thy mighty aids.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः। अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः॥
verses.tr: tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ aśastihā janitā viśvatūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ
verses.en: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish the men who fight with us.

verses.sa: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा। विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि॥
verses.tr: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā viśvāste spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi
verses.en: Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might As sire and mother to their child.

verses.sa: यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भवता मृडयन्तः। आ वोऽर्वाची सुमतिर्ववृत्यादंहोश्चिद्या वरिवोवित्तरासत्॥
verses.tr: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayantaḥ ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādaṃhościdyā varivovittarāsat
verses.en: The sacrifice obtains the Gods' acceptance, etc., as in VIII.

verses.sa: अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष्ट्वं शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम्। हिरण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्यसे रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian aids around, propitious, ne'er beguiled. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.

verses.sa: प्र वीरया शुचयो दद्रिरे वामध्वर्युभिर्मधुमन्तः सुतासः। वह वायो नियुतो याह्यच्छा पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो मदाय॥
verses.tr: pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vāmadhvaryubhirmadhumantaḥ sutāsaḥ vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyacchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya
verses.en: For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed by Adhvaryus, bright sweet-flavoured juices. Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vdyu: drink for thy rapture of the sap of Soma.

verses.sa: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा। उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया॥
verses.tr: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
verses.en: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse.

verses.sa: काव्ययोराजानेषु क्रत्वा दक्षस्य दुरोणे। रिशादसा सधस्थ आ॥
verses.tr: kāvyayorājāneṣu kratvā dakṣasya duroṇe riśādasā sadhastha ā
verses.en: Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the birth With force of intellect unto the dwelling;

verses.sa: दैव्यावध्वर्यू आ गतं रथेन सूर्यत्वचा। मध्वा यज्ञं समञ्जाथे। तं प्रत्नथा ऽयं वेनः॥
verses.tr: daivyāvadhvaryū ā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā madhvā yajñaṃ samañjāthe taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ
verses.en: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse. Thou in ib the time of old. See, Vena.

verses.sa: तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासी३दुपरि स्विदासी३त्। रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन्त्स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात्॥
verses.tr: tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsī3dupari svidāsī3t retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt
verses.en: Transversely was the severing line extended: was it. above, or was it, haply, under? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.

verses.sa: आ रोदसी अपृणदा स्वर्महज्जातं यदेनमपसो अधारयन्। सो अध्वराय परि णीयते कविरत्यो न वाजसातये चनोहितः॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī apṛṇadā svarmahajjātaṃ yadenamapaso adhārayan so adhvarāya pari ṇīyate kaviratyo na vājasātaye canohitaḥ
verses.en: He hath filled heaven and earth and th^e great realm of light, when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold. He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us wealth.

verses.sa: उक्थेभिर्वृत्रहन्तमा या मन्दाना चिदा गिरा। आङ्गूषैराविवासतः॥
verses.tr: ukthebhirvṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cidā girā āṅgūṣairāvivāsataḥ
verses.en: Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of the foe, Delighting even in our hymn.

verses.sa: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये। सुमृडीका भवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śṛṇvantvamṛtasya ye sumṛḍīkā bhavantu naḥ
verses.en: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing. And be exceeding good to us.

verses.sa: ब्रह्माणि मे मतयः शं सुतासः शुष्म इयर्ति प्रभृतो मे अद्रिः। आ शासते प्रति हर्यन्त्युक्थेमा हरी वहतस्ता नो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: brahmāṇi me matayaḥ śaṃ sutāsaḥ śuṣma iyarti prabhṛto me adriḥ ā śāsate prati haryantyukthemā harī vahatastā no accha
verses.en: Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon. They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.

verses.sa: अनुत्तमा ते मघवन्नकिर्नु न त्वावाँ२ अस्ति देवता विदानः। न जायमानो नशते न जातो यानि करिष्या कृणुहि प्रवृद्ध॥
verses.tr: anuttamā te maghavannakirnu na tvāvāṃ2 asti devatā vidānaḥ na jāyamāno naśate na jāto yāni kariṣyā kṛṇuhi pravṛddha
verses.en: Id Nothing, O t) Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None bom or springing into life comes near thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty! I

verses.sa: तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः। सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः॥
verses.tr: tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ
verses.en: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the mighty God of splendid valour. Quickly When born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.

verses.sa: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम। पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत॥
verses.tr: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata
verses.en: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant Wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

verses.sa: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः। तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः॥
verses.tr: yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadhipā ariḥ tiraścidarye ruśame pavīravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiḥ
verses.en: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, D&sas here belong. E*en over unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.

verses.sa: अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे। सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye
verses.en: He, with his might Advanced by Rishis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.

verses.sa: अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष्ट्वं शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम्। हिरण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्यसे रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: , Protect our habitation, Savitar, etc., as in verse.

verses.sa: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः। अन्तः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानोऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno'yaṃ śukro ayāmi te
verses.en: Come, Vayu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining-cloth and dressed, his bright drink hath been offered thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू सुसन्दृशा सुहवेह हवामहे। यथा नः सर्व इज्जनोऽनमीवः सङ्गमे सुमना असत्॥
verses.tr: indravāyū susandṛśā suhaveha havāmahe yathā naḥ sarva ijjano'namīvaḥ saṅgame sumanā asat
verses.en: Indra and Vayu, fair to see and swift to hear, we call to us, That in assembly all, yea, all the folk may be benevolent to us and free from malady.

verses.sa: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये। यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये॥
verses.tr: ṛdhagitthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye yo nūnaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvabhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye
verses.en: Yea, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods, Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varna to share his sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa: आ यातमुप भूषतं मध्वः पिबतमश्विना। दुग्धं पयो वृषणा जेन्यावसू मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतम्॥
verses.tr: ā yātamupa bhūṣataṃ madhvaḥ pibatamaśvinā dugdhaṃ payo vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū mā no mardhiṣṭamā gatam
verses.en: Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of the mead. Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth! 1) Injure us not, and come to us.

verses.sa: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता। अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ
verses.en: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, may the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which gives the fivefold gift the Hero, lover of mankind.

verses.sa: चन्द्रमा अप्स्वन्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि। रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं हरिरेति कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: candramā apsvantarā suparṇo dhāvate divi rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ harireti kanikradat
verses.en: Within the Waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings, in heaven. To yellow-hued abundant wealth, object of many a man's desire, loud neighing goes the tawny Steed.

verses.sa: देवं-देवं वोऽवसे देवं-देवमभिष्टये। देवं-देवं हुवेम वाजसातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया॥
verses.tr: devaṃ-devaṃ vo'vase devaṃ-devamabhiṣṭaye devaṃ-devaṃ huvema vājasātaye gṛṇanto devyā dhiyā
verses.en: Singing their praise with godlike hymn let us invoke each God for grace. Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.

verses.sa: दिवि पृष्टो अरोचताग्निर्वैश्वानरो बृहन्। क्ष्मया वृधान ओजसा चनोहितो ज्योतिषा बाधते तमः॥
verses.tr: divi pṛṣṭo arocatāgnirvaiśvānaro bṛhan kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā canohito jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ
verses.en: Agni Vaisvinara, set in heaven, with mighty splendour hath shone forth. Increasing in his power on earth, benevolent, he quells the darkness with his light.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी अपादियं पूर्वागात् पद्वतीभ्यः। हित्वी शिरो जिह्वया वावदच्चरत्त्रिंशत्पदा न्यक्रमीत्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgāt padvatībhyaḥ hitvī śiro jihvayā vāvadaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt
verses.en: First, Indra-Agni! Agui! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she bath gone downward thirty steps.

verses.sa: देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः। ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः॥
verses.tr: devāso hi ṣmā manave samanyavo viśve sākaṃ sarātayaḥ te no adya te aparaṃ tuce tu no bhavantu varivovidaḥ
verses.en: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts. May they. increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing ease And ample room.

verses.sa: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत्। दवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण॥
verses.tr: apādhamadabhiśastīraśastihāthendro dyumnyābhavat davāsta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa
verses.en: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with the Marut host! I the Gods eagerly strove to win thy love.

verses.sa: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत। वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा॥
verses.tr: pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā
verses.en: To Indra, to your mighty Chief, Maruts, sing forth a mighty prayer. Let $Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, kill the fiend with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि। अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा। इमा उ त्वा यस्यायमयं सहस्रमूर्ध्व ऊ षु णः॥
verses.tr: asyedindro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā imā u tvā yasyāyamayaṃ sahasramūrdhva ū ṣu ṇaḥ
verses.en: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice; And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty. May these. Good Lord of wealth. He with his might. Stand up erect.
